title: Explore OrangeHRM open-source platform modules
description:
This is a  ticket for our upcoming training and demo session on the OrangeHRM open-source system. Use the credentials below to log into the public sandbox environment and test the basic HR modules.

*Access Details:*

* URL: [https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/|https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/|smart-link] 
* Username: Admin
* Password: admin123

*Testing Scope:*
Please log in and perform at least one action in the following modules:

# PIM: Create a test employee record.
# Leave: Submit a practice leave request.
# Recruitment: View current job vacancies.
# Time: Review a sample employee timesheet.

Acceptance Criteria  : 

||Module||Acceptance Criteria||
|*Login*|User can successfully log in to the OrangeHRM sandbox using the provided credentials (Admin / admin123) and is redirected to the dashboard without errors.|
|*PIM – Create Employee*|* User can navigate to *PIM* module.- User can create a new employee by entering the mandatory fields.- Employee record is successfully saved.- Newly created employee is visible in the employee list/search results.|
|*Leave – Submit Leave Request*|* User can navigate to the *Leave* module.- User can create a leave request by selecting a leave type and valid date(s).- Leave request is submitted successfully.- Submitted leave request appears in the leave records/history with the appropriate status.|
|*Recruitment – View Vacancies*|* User can navigate to the *Recruitment* module.- User can access the *Vacancies* page.- Existing job vacancies are displayed.- Vacancy details (e.g., Job Title, Hiring Manager, Status) are visible.|
|*Time – Review Timesheet*|* User can navigate to the *Time* module.- User can access an employee timesheet.- Timesheet details (dates, project/activity, hours worked) are displayed without errors.- User can review the timesheet successfully.|
